name: I WANNA RUN AWAY TOWER
desc:
🎵 Welcome to I WANNA RUN AWAY TOWER! 🎵  
Climb a troll tower with fake paths, falling friends, and the I Wanna Run Away meme song!

🏃 Run while the meme song plays!  
🎥 Record your fails and dances!  
🪙 Get coins at the top!  
🔓 Unlock Runaway meme skins!  
🎯 Troll your friends!

👍 Like & ⭐️ join the group for rewards!
